comments.author: Montador
comments.body: Lower Luxor dungeon. The only available boost to Luxuries trading in the game.

comments.author: Dongwoo
comments.body: Not entirely accurate. If you look up "Lapis", you will find a bunch of accessories that will boost Luxuries trading. But they are very rare and the King's hand mirror that you reference is probably the most easily obtained. Incidentally, I found a Lapis Brooch (memorial album item) last week searching in Naples after the barkeep told me someone had thrown one out. I actually found four of them...Luxuries trading +2.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: This item is dropped (rarely) by the boss on the 15th floor.

comments.author: V_I
comments.body: Also sold in a hidden passage shop in the Karnak and Luxor lower floors for 15,000 Roman Coins. Counts towards the memorial album when purchased!
